## What

One paragraph: the shape of the thing, in plain English.

## Why now

What makes this worth doing at this point rather than later. If it unblocks
something, name it.

## Scope boundary

What this explicitly does **not** cover, so the issue doesn't quietly grow.

## Tracked work

The fine-grained work lives in its own issues, attached here as sub-issues —
let this issue stay a summary.

- [ ] #<issue> — one line
- [ ] #<issue> — one line

## Done when

The observable condition that closes this. Prefer something checkable (a gate
passes, a stage runs clean, a doc says X) over "it feels finished".
